title: Support Desk
summary: Every new ticket is read by a support agent straight away. The agent's browser trusts whatever the ticket says.
objectives: Find where ticket text is shown without encoding
Run your own script in the agent's browser
Bring the agent's integration key back to where you can read it
learningOutcomes: Explain why HttpOnly cookies don't stop an attacker acting as the victim
Fix output encoding and add a Content Security Policy

references.label: OWASP Cross Site Scripting Prevention Cheat Sheet

hints.bodyMd: Try some HTML, such as `bold`, in a ticket. Subjects and replies are encoded; is the description?
The agent's cookie is HttpOnly and the lab has no outbound network. You don't need the cookie: the agent's browser can fetch `/admin` itself and post what it finds as a reply on your ticket.
